DO DIN KI ZINDAGI
Experience the magic of Do Din Ki Zindagi, the second song from Gunmaaster G9, featuring the soulful voices of Shreya Ghoshal and Vishal Mishra, composed by the maestro Himesh Reshammiya, with lyrics by Junaid Wasi.
A Himesh Reshammiya Musical
Song: Do Din Ki Zindagi
Music: Himesh Reshammiya
Lyrics: Junaid Wasi
Singers: Shreya Ghoshal & Vishal Mishra
Music Produced & Arranged by: Meghdeep Bose
